checks.label: Do not patch on top of stale logic
checks.failureMode: A stale backlog item remains open while the proposed fix claims completion.

checks.label: Do not create duplicate systems
checks.failureMode: A new debug, evidence, telemetry, score, route, or cost system duplicates a canonical lane.

checks.label: Do not fake evidence
checks.failureMode: Source-only output is described as runtime, provider, smoke, screenshot, or source proof.

checks.label: Do not clear source evidence gates without records
checks.failureMode: A beta evidence gate is marked resolved without the required generated source record.

checks.label: Do not grow monoliths without split plans
checks.failureMode: A touched source file exceeds module discipline limits without a split plan.

checks.label: Do not touch chat or navigation without explicit request
checks.failureMode: A protected chat or nav path changed outside the prompt scope.

checks.label: Do not touch payment or GumDrop math without explicit request
checks.failureMode: Payment, wallet, PayPal, or GumDrop math paths changed outside the prompt scope.

checks.label: Do not leave debug warnings unowned
checks.failureMode: A debug backlog item lacks owner, surface, or next action.

checks.label: Do not create orphaned telemetry
checks.failureMode: Telemetry changes bypass canonical event fact or catalog ownership.

checks.label: Do not hardcode UI scale regressions
checks.failureMode: UI scale tokens are hardcoded without device/layout doctrine ownership.

checks.label: Do not add cost paths without guardrails
checks.failureMode: A new AI, cloud, analytics, storage, or scheduled path lacks a cost guard.

checks.label: Do not present source readiness as deployed runtime truth
checks.failureMode: Local source checks are used to claim deployed runtime/provider evidence.

findings.title: Stale debug logic is still active
findings.detail: Open stale backlog items are classified as refresh, source evidence, or operator context work; they must stay visible but do not imply a source code request-change.
findings.requiredFix: Keep the stale backlog item visible in the owning evidence or refresh lane until the required artifact changes.

findings.title: Potential duplicate debug system
findings.detail: The changed files look like a parallel debug, telemetry, score, or evidence system instead of a refinement of the canonical lane.
findings.requiredFix: Refactor into the existing debug backlog, evidence, telemetry, or score owner instead of adding a parallel system.

findings.title: Monolith split plan required
findings.detail: A changed source file exceeds the repo module-size budget.
findings.requiredFix: Split logic into contract, builder, validator, and view/source helpers or document a bounded split plan.
